meta.name: Hush Edition
meta.notes: Warm paper-white template palette; --c-primary appears only as a 4% mat tint behind products, the cart-count pill, the active filter underline and the add-to-cart button.

issues: Top-left brand is invisible for Banks Mansion: the crawled logo is a white SVG with logoIsLight=false, so the header looks brandless; on the stress brand it shows a partner logo instead of the shop name
An empty black toast box sits mid-right on every page (hidden only by transform, still painted in full-page renders)
Hierarchy breaks the art direction: section, story and CTA headings are as big as the hero headline, so the hero is not the single large type moment
The sparse asymmetric index reads as missing items/empty gaps rather than a deliberate catalogue
Catalog grid is pushed right by an extra 1/12 left padding, misaligned with the headline and filter bar
Scores: creativity 7, typography 6.5, layout & rhythm 6.5, polish 6, brand-colour robustness 7.5, mobile 6.5, generic-ness 6.5
fixed: Brand is now the shop name set tiny in tracked caps top-left on both pages, independent of unreliable logo files
Toast is visibility:hidden until shown, removing the stray black box
Hero headline scaled up (to 120px) and all section/story/CTA headings reduced to a quiet 26–40px, so the hero is the only large type
Added leading-zero catalogue numbers (01, 02…) before every product name on home and catalog so the scattered index reads as an intentional edition index
Catalog grid realigned to the page margins for a calm, even three-column layout; catalog CTA heading quieted to match
